interview.hardest_part: Surviving the increasingly complex document rules, time pressure, and citation/financial economy long enough to reach workday 20, then steering the story to a qualifying ending.
interview.likely_failure: Accumulating inspection errors or running out of money/time before reaching later workdays, and if day 20 is reached, missing the specific ending requirements for endings 16, 18, 19, or 20.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The visible document interface supports direct click/drag inspection, rules are provided in-game, stamps and decision controls are explicit, and milestones only require reaching workdays after genuine processing rather than perfect play.
interview.harmful_mechanics: The real-time workday clock keeps running while thinking, input is limited to one mouse action per step, documents contain small text and subtle discrepancies, rules change frequently, citations and family/rent costs create cumulative failure pressure, and the final milestone requires one of only four specific endings.
